title: Poached Eggs with Ham in Orange Cream Sauce
blurb: Soft poached eggs and sliced ham in a silky orange sauce, sharpened with vinegar and black pepper.
steps: Zest two of the oranges finely, then juice all of them to give about 300ml of juice.
Pour the juice into a wide saucepan with the vinegar and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Let it bubble gently for 20 minutes until reduced by half.
Stir in the cream and orange zest, then season with salt and pepper. Simmer for another 10 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly and coats the back of a spoon.
Slice the ham into thick pieces and lay them in the sauce to warm through for 3 minutes.
Bring a separate pan of water to a gentle simmer with a pinch of salt. Crack each egg into the water and poach for 3 to 4 minutes until the whites are set but the yolks remain runny.
Lift the eggs out with a slotted spoon and drain briefly on kitchen paper.
Divide the ham between four plates, spoon over the orange sauce, and place a poached egg on top of each serving.
